normal_technical_review.method: Inspect implementation, run the full suite, and report defects and readiness.
findings: The implementation and repository validation suite pass.
The CLI is offline and deterministic.
One workflow task remains gated on human approval.
limitations: Does not require source provenance for the named council.
Does not prove every pinned council entry is represented exactly once.
Does not distinguish observed Current evidence from conditional North Star evidence by contract.

distinct_falsifiable_value.falsifier: Remove, duplicate, expire, or mismatch any council lens, review manifest, version pin, or contribution; the completeness test must fail.
Enable a socket attempt or change one rendered byte between repeated pinned runs; the offline or digest test must fail.

distinct_falsifiable_value.claim: Observed and conditional evidence remain separate.
distinct_falsifiable_value.falsifier: Reference a North Star item from a Current score or a Current item from a North Star score; contract validation must fail.

guru_benchmark_review.additional_finding: Release remains conditional because automated safety evidence does not substitute for the required human architecture acceptance.
limitations: Scores remain bounded judgments rather than empirical product outcomes.
Source validity expires and requires periodic re-review.
The self-review cannot provide independent evidence of real-world adoption.

repair_tasks.weakness: Human acceptance of the foundational public-renderer boundary is unrecorded.
repair_tasks.proof: Human architecture review is approved and the task finishes.

repair_tasks.weakness: Council completeness and zero-gap output previously lacked one executable proof.
repair_tasks.proof: The council completeness test, offline render, and zero-gap audit all pass.
